test_case.test_name: MP5 CCD-local correctable error and compute/firmware continuity
test_case.purpose: For each approved MP5/socket/CCD target, inject one authoritative CE, prove exactly one fresh controller-specific event with no reset/UCE, and retain compute, NUMA and firmware-managed services.
required_package: MP5-specific CE count/source and no-reset oracle
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the tuple. After approval, baseline the mapped CCD, MP5 telemetry and raw controls, run one authorized CE once, correlate exactly one fresh MP5 source event with no reset/UCE, then restore and validate cores, NUMA, sensors, power/thermal behavior and bounded workload.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one fresh MP5 CE identifies the intended CCD/index within timeout; no UCE/BERT/reset or persistent error occurs; all cores/NUMA nodes and firmware services remain healthy; settings equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until tuple/coverage and thresholds are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic corrected text, wrong index/CCD, multiple/no events, reset/UCE, missing cores, sensor/control anomaly or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated monitored SUT with independent console and stable thermal/power margin.
Abort on reset, UCE, wrong source, missing core/NUMA, firmware/sensor failure or thermal anomaly.
expected_evidence: MP5/CCD topology and vendor tuple contract
Exactly one fresh MP5 CE with zero UCE delta
test_case.recovery: Restore threshold/debug/BIOS/HDT and MP5 state; cover unexpected reset/UCE, compute loss or firmware-service failure via approved OOB recovery. Execution remains blocked until approved.
